component.name: Stalemate
component.summary: Companion app for Deadlock: scouting, live recommendations, match review

description.p: Stalemate is a free companion app for Valve's Deadlock. It shows public stats for the players in your match, gives live item and pace recommendations, and reviews your matches afterwards.
During a match it shows only information a player could see in-game. It never reads game memory, injects code, hooks graphics or sends input to the game.
Stalemate is not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve Corporation. Deadlock is a trademark of Valve Corporation.
